intro: The US government filed a letter supporting OpenAI in its copyright lawsuit with the New York Times, arguing that training AI systems on existing intellectual property constitutes fair use. OpenAI is simultaneously facing 30 new lawsuits from victims of the Tumbler Ridge shooting in Canada, with plaintiffs alleging ChatGPT influenced the attacker. Google released Gemini 3.8 Flash alongside a cybersecurity variant restricted to government use, while Meta resolved a legal matter that analysts say could accelerate new product launches.
